# Local Boys Storage

> Family-owned self storage in Collingwood, Ontario, Canada. Secure, insulated 8 x 20 ft storage units for household and business storage, serving Collingwood, Wasaga Beach, The Blue Mountains, Thornbury, Stayner, Creemore, Clearview, Nottawa, Tiny and all of South Georgian Bay.

Local Boys Storage is locally owned and operated by Jack Garbutt. The facility is at 9599 Beachwood Rd, Collingwood, ON L9Y 5P1. Units are rented by phone or through the website contact form.

## Pages

- [Home](https://localboysstorage.ca/): Overview, service area, container sizes and top questions.
- [Storage Units](https://localboysstorage.ca/storage-units): Unit size, insulation, security and rental options.
- [FAQ](https://localboysstorage.ca/faq): Answers about unit sizes, insulation, security, hours, service area, insurance, locks and rental terms.
- [Contact Us](https://localboysstorage.ca/contact-us): Phone, email, address and message form to reserve a unit.

## Storage units

- Size: every unit is 8 ft wide, 20 ft long and 8 ft high (about a single-car garage).
- Space: 160 sq ft of floor space and over 5,000 cubic ft of storage.
- Construction: vented, spray-foam insulated containers; weather proof, moisture-free and rodent-free.
- Security: 24/7 security with cameras, gated access and secure locks.
- Hours: open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
- Access: wide driveways for moving trucks.
- Rentals: flexible short-term rentals and long-term leases.
- Locks: bring your own or buy a high-quality lock on site.
- Insurance: customers are encouraged to carry their own insurance on stored items.
- Good for: household goods, seasonal items, recreational gear, tools and business inventory.

## Service area

Collingwood, Wasaga Beach, The Blue Mountains, Thornbury, Stayner, Creemore, Clearview, Nottawa and Tiny, Ontario (South Georgian Bay, Simcoe County and Grey County).
